name: Beast Below

features.name: Expanding siren wilds
features.description: Sirens expand upwards when that creates a win and carry multipliers up to 200x.

features.name: Additive multipliers
features.description: Multiple sirens on a line add their multipliers together.

features.name: Sirens' Call free spins
features.description: Three FS symbols award 10 free spins with more sirens and special pink sirens.

review:
A deep-sea 5x4, 14-liner where the sirens are the stars. These wilds expand to the top of the grid when that makes a win, carrying multipliers up to 200x, and several on one line add together.

Only yellow sirens appear in the base game, and they vanish after each spin. Three FS symbols give 10 Sirens' Call free spins with more sirens, special pink ones that stick around, and divers hunting the Beast. Rated 4/5 for volatility, 10,000x max. Top RTP 96.29%, but versions go down to 88.28% – check the info screen.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.28% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
